_description: Reward function weight configuration for the AEGIS multi-junction RL agent.

queue_weight.description: Negative normalized network queue length. Primary signal driving the agent to minimize overall congestion across all lanes.

spillback_weight.description: Penalty applied when any lane exceeds 80% of its capacity, discouraging upstream spillback and gridlock propagation.

switch_weight.description: Penalty for each phase switch to discourage rapid cycling and ensure minimum green time is respected.
